I am a Ph.D. student in Economics at the Andrew Young School of Policy Studies, Georgia State University. My research interests are in urban economics.

My long-term interest is in **urban memory**: how the places we inherit shape the lives we can build. I am interested in how inherited urban spaces and institutions shape people’s feasible opportunities, and how those opportunities change across generations.
